source: Claude pricing page, https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, read 16 Nov 2026 (WORK-10-DESIGN.md section 2). US dollars per million tokens. A request's prompt length counts all of its input tokens, including cache reads and cache writes; Haiku 5.5 prices a call by that length, over 100,000 tokens at the second tier. Opus 5.5 is one price across its 1M context. Every call is priced from its own fresh, cache-write and cache-read tokens (decision 12).
